faq.question: What is the Lovart AI Bar Menu Maker?
faq.answer: The Lovart AI Bar Menu Maker is part of Lovart, the World's First AI Design Agent. It uses MCoT (Multi-step Chain of Thought) as your Creative Director to design professional bar menus — from cocktail lists to wine catalogs — all through natural language prompts on ChatCanvas.

faq.question: Is Lovart free for bar menu design?
faq.answer: Yes! Lovart offers free daily credits so you can try AI bar menu design at no cost. Experiment with cocktail menus, wine lists, and beer boards before committing to a paid plan.

faq.question: What are Lovart's pricing plans for professional use?
faq.answer: Lovart offers three monthly subscription plans: Starter at 2,000 credits/month, Basic at 3,500 credits/month, and Pro at 11,000 credits/month. All paid plans include full commercial usage rights for your bar menu designs.

faq.question: Do I get commercial rights for my bar menus?
faq.answer: Yes, all paid Lovart plans (Starter, Basic, and Pro) include full commercial usage rights. You own every bar menu you design and can use them commercially, print unlimited copies, and distribute them to multiple locations without restrictions.

faq.question: What file formats can I export my bar menu in?
faq.answer: Lovart supports 8K resolution export in PNG, JPG, SVG, and PSD formats. SVG is ideal for scalable bar signage and digital table displays, PSD for advanced editing and premium printing, and PNG/JPG for social media and web use.

faq.question: How does Touch Edit work for bar menus?
faq.answer: Touch Edit lets you click any element on your bar menu directly on ChatCanvas — a cocktail name, price, ingredient list, or decorative illustration — and modify it instantly. No layers panel, no complex tools, just click and edit.

faq.question: How does Text Edit work for updating drink prices and descriptions?
faq.answer: Text Edit enables instant text modifications on your bar menu. Click any text element to update drink names, prices, tasting notes, or add seasonal specials. Changes appear immediately on ChatCanvas, and you can edit across multiple sections in rapid succession.

faq.question: Can Lovart handle different bar menu styles?
faq.answer: Yes. Lovart's MCoT agent excels at diverse bar menu types — craft cocktail menus with illustrated recipes, curated wine lists with tasting notes, craft beer boards with flavor profiles, bar food menus with pairing suggestions, and seasonal rotating menus. Describe your vision and the AI adapts.

faq.question: Does Lovart keep my bar's branding consistent across all menus?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Once Lovart understands your bar's brand identity — signature colors, typography, logo treatment, and visual mood — it applies consistent branding across your cocktail menu, wine list, food menu, and seasonal specials for a unified guest experience.

faq.answer: 當然可以。Lovart 的 MCoT 代理擅長各種酒吧菜單——帶插畫配方的精調雞尾酒單、附品酒筆記的精選葡萄酒單、含風味描述的啤酒板、帶配餐建議的酒吧小品菜單，以及季節性輪換菜單。描述你的構想，AI 即可為你量身適配。

faq.question: Lovart 能否讓我酒吧的品牌在所有菜單上保持一致？
faq.answer: 絕對可以。一旦 Lovart 了解了你酒吧的品牌識別——標誌色、字體、Logo 處理和視覺氛圍——它就會在你的雞尾酒單、葡萄酒單、小品菜單和季節特調中統一應用品牌風格，為客人帶來一致的品牌體驗。
